search.placeholder: Describe your situation in your own words…
search.answerTitleDefault: Ask anything about your compliance obligations
search.answerBody1: This is what likely applies to a situation like yours, with the source behind each point. The answer comes from our AI: general information, not individual legal advice.
search.answerBody2: Your business may differ — thresholds, registers and deadlines depend on your markets, your business model and your volume. Which of them apply to you is what the assessment below works out.

o1.title: VAT / OSS registration
o1.detail: Cross-border distance sales above the EU threshold trigger OSS registration and quarterly returns.

o2.title: EPR / packaging registration
o2.detail: Placing packaged goods on the market requires producer registration before the first shipment.

o3.title: Cookie consent & privacy notice
o3.detail: Consumer-facing tracking requires prior consent and a GDPR-compliant privacy notice.
